boundary_f1: boundary precision and recall within the fixed pixel tolerance
confidence_interval: paired scene means with complete asset groups resampled together
detection_aware_metrics: missed references contribute zero; unmatched predictions remain counted
dice: twice the intersection divided by total foreground area
mask_iou: intersection divided by union for matched binary masks
ranking_metrics: B0, B1 and P1 are deferred to Notebook 07

routes.automatic_box: SAM 2.1 prompted with frozen LocateAnything boxes
